Running the bus N->S puts it on M5, free over the macros: ~9,800 derated vertical tracks (M5 full width + M3 in channels) vs ~3,100 = 0.32; face 2,079 pins at 3 M5 tracks = 300 of 471 um. Outline 475.2 (11 x 43.2) x 216 for a 63 um mid channel (512 macro-edge pins/row). r5g: east column MY-mirrored (like pin sets face like channels).
